summary: All five High and seven Medium findings are accepted for remediation. None requires changing Pytincture's class-level BFF decorator contract or making Redis, process-memory sessions, or sticky routing mandatory.

findings.title: Automatic assistant-message DOM XSS
findings.disposition: remediate in dhxpyt and pin the complete patched wheel in Pytincture
findings.compatibility_note: Artifact titles and identifiers now render as text; applications relying on raw HTML there must use an explicit sanitized rich-content path. Normal chat and BFF use is unchanged.
regression_tests: pytincture/frontend/tests/lifecycle.test.mjs::the built-in dhxpyt release verifies the complete PyPI wheel

findings.title: Artifact preview escapes iframe isolation
findings.disposition: isolate untrusted previews and disable automatic model-supplied Python execution
findings.compatibility_note: Same-origin interactive scripts, parent-DOM access, network-capable previews, and automatic Python execution no longer work. Plain text, code, and passive media previews remain supported.
regression_tests: pytincture/frontend/tests/lifecycle.test.mjs::widget asset loader is manifest-only and verifies ownership and hashes

findings.title: Ordinary widget data reaches HTML sinks
findings.disposition: treat ordinary values as text and separate explicit sanitized rich-content APIs
findings.compatibility_note: Markup inserted as ordinary Grid, Listbox, Combobox, CardFlow, or CardPanel data is escaped. Sanitized rich-content options and trusted developer-supplied DOM templates remain explicit APIs.

findings.title: Encrypted SAML assertion bypasses transform preflight
findings.disposition: reject encrypted assertions until transform validation is guaranteed before xmlsec signature processing
findings.compatibility_note: Deployments using encrypted assertions must temporarily configure signed plaintext assertions. Other authentication methods, sessions, and BFFs are unchanged.

findings.title: Pickle IPC defeats isolated BFF process boundary
findings.disposition: replace pickle with bounded non-executable byte messages
findings.compatibility_note: Supported JSON-compatible BFF results remain unchanged; arbitrary pickled results were never part of the public contract.

findings.title: Timed-out synchronous streams leave orphan threads
findings.disposition: keep work admitted until completion or run it in a bounded killable executor
findings.compatibility_note: Indefinitely blocking synchronous iterators retain one configured admission slot until they exit; finite iterators and cooperative async streams remain supported without API changes.

findings.title: Public wheel requests repeatedly hash entire files
findings.disposition: cache verified digests, bound wheel size and admission, and support conditional requests
findings.compatibility_note: Backend wheel fallback order and URLs remain unchanged. Wheels above the new 64 MiB default require an explicit deployment limit increase, and excessive callers can receive 429 or 503 with Retry-After.
regression_tests: pytincture/frontend/tests/lifecycle.test.mjs::backend wheel probe uses metadata first and hashes only an uncached wheel

findings.title: Weak artifact messaging and unbounded plaintext chat persistence
findings.compatibility_note: Oversized histories and logs are truncated or evicted, direct postMessage integrations must use the bound preview channel, and artifact-console text is excluded from model requests unless explicitly enabled. Existing applications that supplied storageKey retain local persistence; applications without an explicit persistence choice no longer store chat content.
regression_tests: pytincture/frontend/tests/lifecycle.test.mjs::the built-in dhxpyt release verifies the complete PyPI wheel

findings.title: Synchronous BFF transport and replay refill races
findings.disposition: add deadline-bounded async transport and single-flight refills without masking completed mutations
findings.compatibility_note: Existing synchronous generated methods remain throughout 1.x and emit a normally hidden deprecation warning. Each receives an additive method_async companion; new code should await it for bounded non-blocking transport. The class-level decorator, backend method, stateless sessions, and no-Redis deployment model are unchanged.

findings.title: Proxy example and edge auditor can certify spoofable forwarding
findings.disposition: replace forwarded client IPs and audit/probe the exact target vhost
findings.compatibility_note: Unsafe proxy configurations that previously passed qualification now fail until corrected, and old production-edge evidence must be regenerated with the expanded schema. Correctly configured proxies and application APIs are unchanged; the read-only client-peer probe is stateless, bounded, and no-store.

findings.title: Release validation ignores tar links and special members
findings.disposition: reject every non-directory and non-regular archive member
findings.compatibility_note: Normal Pytincture artifacts are unaffected. Nonstandard custom archives containing links, devices, FIFOs, malformed paths, or duplicate normalized names now fail closed during normalization, inspection, and retained-artifact publication verification.

findings.title: Dependency and repository integrity gaps
findings.disposition: require secret scan, whole-wheel verification, explicit external-runtime trust, lifecycle minimization, and independent clean rebuilds
findings.compatibility_note: Custom widget wheels or external Pyodide deployments may need administrator hashes or explicit development trust opt-in; runtime BFF APIs remain unchanged.
